parsed.rationale: The second participating record (`Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, line 63) carries `is_sample_app: true`, placing it squarely in a sample/example application. The near-identical `DebugMetricsProvider` in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` is the canonical implementation in the `DebugPanel` package; the sample-app copy is a self-contained convenience duplicate that avoids a hard dependency from the `Wallpaper` example target onto `DebugPanel`. The only structural difference — `metalDevice:MTLDevice?` vs `metalDevice:(any MTLDevice)?` — is a minor existential-syntax variant consistent with independent, loosely-maintained sample code rather than a shared abstraction. Introducing a PAT or extracting a shared type would force the `WallpaperSampleApp` example to take on a real package dependency, which is typically undesirable for sample apps.
